component.name: Launcher Editor
启动器编辑器
component.summary: Manage desktop entries and application icons
管理桌面应用条目和图标

description.p: Launcher Editor is a focused utility for the desktop files that make up your application launcher.

ul.li: Create and edit user desktop entries with Freedesktop-compliant fields.
Hide or show entries without touching package-managed files.
Place application shortcuts on the desktop and remove them again.
Import images into a multi-size user icon theme.

description.p: System applications are read-only. A small user-directory override is used to hide them, so no root access is required and package upgrades are safe.
启动器编辑器是一款专注于应用启动器条目的桌面小工具。

ul.li: 按照 Freedesktop 规范创建和编辑用户级桌面条目。
在不改动软件包文件的情况下隐藏或显示应用。
在桌面上放置或移除应用快捷方式。
把图片导入为多尺寸的用户图标主题图标。

description.p: 系统应用为只读；隐藏系统应用时只写入一个很小的用户目录覆盖标记， 无需 root，也不会被软件包升级覆盖。
